fusions.name: Gnawing Wave
fusions.desc: Looses a gnawing cloud ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything within 3 tiles in front of you, and you heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Strip the Field
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed prong that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Cloud of Mouths
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 12 seconds that gnaws an enemy within 5 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave it [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Famine Tally
fusions.desc: When you kill something, you heal for 25% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
